code: a <- sigfig(3.2, 1) b <- sigfig(4.12, 2) a + b #> <sigfig[1]> #> [1] 7.3 prec_value(a + b) #> [1] 7.32 y <- sigfig(rep(0.04, 10), p = 1)  # Rounding every step: each 0.04 becomes 0.0 Reduce(`+`, round(prec_value(y), 1)) #> [1] 0  # Keeping the full value, and rounding once to display sum(y) #> <sigfig[1]> #> [1] 0.4 Reduce(`+`, as.list(y)) #> <sigfig[1]> #> [1] 0.4 a * 2 #> <sigfig[1]> #> [1] 6.4 a + 5 #> <sigfig[1]> #> [1] 8.2 a + sigfig(5, NA) #> <sigfig[1]> #> [1] 8.2
